title: Plant KPIs in three minutes
intro: One screen for the manager: the last eight weeks of the plant, drawn from the same data the line writes to, and Jonah, an operations agent that reads the same numbers.

steps.title: This week against last
steps.body: Output per day, first-pass yield, lead time, on-time delivery, work in progress and overtime. Green and red arrows say which way each moved.

steps.title: Live from the line
steps.body: When the Paper Airplane Line is running today, its real shifts show here: completed, scrapped, stockouts and work in progress by station. Same data stream, no copy.

steps.title: Demand, orders, production orders, purchases
steps.body: End demand is nearly flat. Each step upstream swings more. That amplification is the bullwhip, and it is the first thing Jonah will point at.

steps.title: Daily output against takt
steps.body: Bars by weekday against the takt line (what demand asks for). Fridays are pushed, Mondays idle. Overtime is drawn on top.

steps.title: Work in progress by station
steps.body: Where the pile grows is the constraint. Body Fold carries most of it, and lead time follows the pile.

steps.title: Quality
steps.body: Defect rate by day, by station and by kind. Watch how the rate climbs on the push days.

steps.title: Ask Jonah
steps.body: Managers can ask what is going on, what to look for on the floor, and what one change to try this week. Each answer shows what it cost. Ask about a chart with the button under it.

steps.title: Feedback, same as every screen
steps.body: If a chart is missing or a number is wrong, say so here. It goes to the improvement board and can become a change to this very page.
